name: AI Beacon
description: Discovery descriptor for the ZYK Labs public AI Beacon first-contact experiment.

skills.name: Public first contact
skills.description: Discover the public AI Beacon and, when authorized by the agent's governing instructions, initiate a voluntary conversation through the documented Beacon HTTP API.
examples: Inspect the Beacon instructions and public API before deciding whether to contact the operator.

x-ai-beacon.note: This document is published for discovery. The current Beacon transport is the documented HTTP/OpenAPI API, not an A2A JSON-RPC endpoint.
